infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Panda Vault uses Face ID to securely unlock your digital vault without re-entering your master password.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Panda Vault accesses your photos and videos to encrypt and store them securely.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Panda Vault uses your camera to capture encrypted photos and videos directly into your vault.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow Panda Vault to use Face ID for biometric authentication.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you upload and encrypt them in Panda Vault.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to let you securely take photos and videos to store in Panda Vault.
